thread:
lina: FYI pushed the Vela30b quant sweep results — FP16/BF16/INT8/FP8 across H100/A100 in us/eu/apac. keeping it high level first, details below.
amar: awesome, thanks. what was the test harness and batch sizes?
lina: harness = internal perf-runner v2.3 (same as prior qbench). seq=1024, microbatch=1/2/4, p50/p95/p99 measured. throughput measured at 90% tail SLO. kernels: flash_attn v2, fused_matmul, and fallback to cuops for INT8 where needed.
matt: any quality regressions on chat eval sets?
lina: running eval-suite (1000 prompts, 5 refs) — summary: FP16 ~baseline, BF16 identical, INT8 median -0.9% QA score, FP8 median -0.6% (but FP8 variance higher for some prompt types). notable regressions on math and long-context retention for INT8 in apac region with smallbatch=1.
hannah: can you paste the perf deltas? p50/p99 and tokens/s per GPU?
lina: sure — short table (tokens/s = total tokens generated per second at steady throughput):
```
Region | GPU  | quant  | p50(ms) | p99(ms) | tokens/s
US     | H100 | FP16   |  45     | 120     | 9500
US     | H100 | FP8    |  34 (-25%)| 95 (-21%) | 12500 (+32%)
EU     | A100 | FP16   |  60     | 150     | 6400
EU     | A100 | INT8   |  44 (-27%)| 115 (-23%) | 8600 (+34%)
APAC   | H100 | INT8   |  48 (-12%)| 140 (-7%) | 8200 (+15%)
APAC   | H100 | FP8    |  36 (-20%)| 110 (-21%) | 11800 (+44%)
```
(lina: numbers rounded, p50 improvements in parentheses vs FP16 baseline on same hardware)
jay: interesting that FP8 beats INT8 on H100 for tokens/s. kernel differences?
lina: FP8 path used new fused-kernel chain with optimized attention + kv-cache packing; INT8 path on H100 still uses mixed cuops kernels leading to less efficient memlayout. on A100 INT8 kernel mapping is better.
amar: capacity sizing impact? can we translate tokens/s to instances per 1k rps?
lina: rough calc: assume avg resp=150 tokens -> 1k rps = 150k tokens/s. so on H100/FP8 (~12k tokens/s) you'd need ~13 instances to support 1k rps at steady state (with 20% headroom -> 16 instances). A100/INT8 (~8.6k) -> ~18 w/ headroom.
matt: any stability issues in long-run? errors, oom, recovers?
lina: on APAC INT8 we saw occasional kv-cache misalignment that caused silent decode stalls in 1/5000 requests — repro logged and filed (perf-bot created perf-972). FP8 path had a small memory leak on fused kernel that we patched in kernel v1.2.4 and retested.
hannah: which rollout recommendation? canary or region-specific pins?
jay: I'd prefer region-specific pins: enable FP8 on US/H100; A/B test INT8 on EU/A100 with fallback to FP16 if QoS drops >1.5% on eval set; block APAC/INT8 until kv-cache issue resolved.
lina: agreed. I'll open a rollout PR with config:
```
routes:
  vela30b:
    us:
      preferred: vela30b-fp8-h100:v1
      fallback: vela30b-fp16-h100:v1
    eu:
      preferred: vela30b-int8-a100:v1
      fallback: vela30b-fp16-a100:v1
    apac:
      preferred: vela30b-fp16-h100:v1
      fallback: vela30b-fp8-h100:v1
```
amar: add automatic eval hooks (daily) and alert if eval delta > 1% or p99 regresses >10%
lina: yep. also adding microbench job commands for reproducibility:
```
./perf-runner --model vela30b --quant FP8 --gpu h100 --seq 1024 --microbatch 1 --runs 300
```
perf-bot: perf-972 created by lina. artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/vela30b/2400001234/artifacts.tar.gz
jay: thanks — can you attach the per-prompt diffs in the PR? I'd like to see which patterns fail for INT8.
lina: will attach diffs + ADC logs. planning to start Canary in us tomorrow at 10:00 PT. will update here after 2h. :rocket:
